title: x² + y² = 1 is not a function of x
caption: At x = 0 the relation x² + y² = 1 holds for both y = 1 and y = −1, so the input 0 has two outputs. Only the upper half y = √(1 − x²) is a function.
alt: The unit circle with the points (0, 1) and (0, −1) joined by a vertical dashed line at x = 0.
description: The relation is the unit circle.
At x = 0 the circle has two points, (0, 1) and (0, −1).
A function gives one output per input, so the relation is not a function.
Cutting it to the upper half gives y = √(1 − x²), which is.

checks.name: (0, 1) and (0, −1) both lie on x² + y² = 1
